visual.description: Warm off-white paper tone — the base surface of all pages, like cream cartridge paper.
Lightest paper surface — used for card backgrounds and elevated elements.
Slightly darker warm paper — used for inset sections and alternate backgrounds.
Deep warm paper tone — used for footer and dark section backgrounds.
Warm near-black — primary text colour, feels like dark ink on paper.
Warm mid-brown — secondary body copy, captions, meta information.
Terracotta/burnt orange — primary accent for links, CTAs and highlight tape strips.
Sage green — secondary accent for badges, tags and decorative pin dots.
Warm yellow — sticky note and tape highlight colour, post-it UI components.
Warm taupe — used for borders and dividers that feel like pencil lines.
Pure white — Polaroid frame background, feels like photo paper.

_twist.twistApplied: Custom warm paper palette — scrapbook/collage aesthetic with cream paper tones, terracotta accent, sage secondary, and yellow sticky-note highlight. All surfaces are warm-tinted paper analogues.
